raw_snippet: We are excited to announce that Comet has been included as a Representative Vendor in the Gartner Market Guide for AI Evaluation and Observability Platforms, published February 2, 2026, for our flagship product, Opik.
value_text: Gartner publishes a Market Guide for AI evaluation and observability platforms (2 Feb 2026)
note: A vendor listed in the guide announcing it; Gartner's own page is for its clients. Evidence that checking AI's work is being sold as its own category.
